code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    background=grid[0][0]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != background or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]; edge=False
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: edge=True
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==background and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            if not edge:
                fill=7 if len(cells)%2 else 2
                for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=fill
    return out
'''
